verdict.rationale: Workable lists a custom report builder on its pricing page, and its documented REST API exposes read endpoints for jobs, candidates, stages, requisitions, offers and events, plus webhooks. An analyst could pull raw recruiting data into a warehouse, but only by building their own pipeline. Nothing in the evidence shows a reporting-specific API, scheduled exports, or BI connectors, and the report builder is only a one-line pricing mention. missing for 10: scheduled report exports, native BI/warehouse connectors, a reporting/analytics API endpoint, documentation of report-builder capabilities, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent corroboration.
